what: Past 500px of scrolling, the header’s menu row slides up −200% and hides (.4s), and in its place a ‹Menu + two lines› burger button floats up from 30px below (.4s). Side items like the Hero copy fade out at .4s and the logo is flagged to shrink. Scrolling back up reverses it. On narrow screens (768 and below) only the burger shows from the start.

options.at: Changes after scrolling this many px, default 500
options.narrow: Below this width (px) it starts as burger only, default 769
options.--fx-rise: Distance the burger rises (via style), default 30px
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Side elements that disappear together (optional, multiple) — hero copy, sound button
options.[data-fx-part=shrink]: Receives is-fx-small (optional) — the size that shrinks the logo is up to the consumer’s css

from.where: shared.js fixed header — .u-nav goes hide, .u-burger goes show, logo 69→56px, copy and sound button fadeOut(400)
